Your Rural Livelihood is in Good Hands.
At FCA/Vision Ag, we serve our communities in southeastern Iowa with a sense of purpose. We're here for our members and customers at the highest level.
Choose us for your needs for your farm, home, and business and you’ll become part of the FCA/Vision Ag family!
We’re looking to start a relationship that can endure for generations.
Become a Member
FCA/Vision Ag Products and Services
AGRONOMY
The strength of FCA/Vision Ag's agronomy services starts with our hard-working and knowledgeable team. Our goal is simple: To help our farmers be as successful as they can be.
AGRONOMY
GRAIN
The grain team at FCA/Vision Ag is your partner for getting the most value from every bushel of grain. We bring the knowledge to help deliver more profits to your operation.
GRAIN
ENERGY
For high-quality fuels, lubricants and propane, FCA/Vision Ag is the preferred choice. We back every product with our customer-focused approach.
ENERGY
FEED
The feed team at FCA/Vision Ag genuinely wants to see our producers succeed. That’s why we place extra emphasis on customer service and providing good, sound, quality nutrition.

HARVEST PHOTO CONTEST! 📸
October is National Co-op Month, and we're celebrating the hardworking farmers who make our community what it is! We want to see your best harvest photos of your favorite farmers working hard out in the field.
HOW TO ENTER:
1️⃣ Post your harvest photo in the comments of this post
2️⃣ Like this post 👍
3️⃣ Share this post to your page
📅 Entries accepted: October 13 – October 29 (cutoff at 3PM)
🗳️ Voting: October 30 – November 6 (cutoff at 1PM) on a separate post, so keep an eye out!
What's the Prize? A bucket full of FCA & Vision Ag Swag including a Carhartt 1/4 Zip Sweatshirt!
This contest is Facebook only.
We can't wait to see all of your amazing harvest photos! Happy Co-op Month! 💚
*Selected photos will be used on FCA/Vision Ag LLC social media platforms and in various promotional projects. You are encouraged to submit your best high-resolution photos.
